objective: Close a handoff that appears complete but has no explicit stop or recheck conditions.
what_changed: Summarized the completed code review and claimed the follow-up is ready to close.
unresolved: The next self has no stated condition for when to stop or recheck the claim.
must_preserve: Completion Integrity requires visible stop conditions.
PASS is not a truth guarantee.
V12 Gate is not for optimizing records toward PASS.
restart_point: Resume by checking whether the review evidence still supports the claimed closure.
reanchor_condition: Re-anchor if review evidence changes or a missing stop condition cannot be reconstructed.
next_self_should_not: Do not close this as PASS just because the summary sounds complete.
Do not remove the missing stop-condition issue to make the record cleaner.
notes: This example prevents False Completion by delaying closure when the stop condition is missing.
